Class AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenEditQueue

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenEditQueue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private final class AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenEditQueue extends Object implements Runnable
The class TokenEditQueue listens for cell-input edits and runs the newest one. The queue holds the pending edits in an ArrayDeque. The worker thread is named aetheris-token-edit. The worker thread is a daemon. The worker does not touch a Swing component. The event-dispatch thread, the thread Swing uses for components, does not wait on this thread. A caller calls start() once. A caller calls offer(String) on the event-dispatch thread when a cell input changes. A caller calls dropPending() on the event-dispatch thread when a newer edit claims the sequence. An older edit that has not started is dropped. An edit whose sequence is no longer current is not painted. // @aa-sdd GK-0604 aetheris-plan-f-189.001.md FINESSE:f-189

  • Method Details

    • start

      void start()
      The method starts the worker thread.

    • offer

      void offer(String cellId)
      The method records one new edit and drops every edit that is still waiting. The method is called on the event-dispatch thread. The method increments the shared edit sequence. The method stores one new AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenEdit for that sequence and cellId. The waiting queue is cleared before the new edit is added. The method then notifies the worker.
      Parameters:
      cellId - The cell id is the id of the card that edited.

    • dropPending

      void dropPending()
      The method clears every edit that is still waiting. The method is called on the event-dispatch thread when a newer edit claims the sequence. An estimate that is already running still finishes. That finished estimate then sees that a newer sequence exists.

    • run

      public void run()
      The method is the worker loop, and the loop does not return. The method takes one AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenEdit. A null edit is skipped. An edit is skipped when newerWaiting() is already true. The method copies a AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenSeat through capture(TokenEdit). A null seat is skipped. A seat whose sequence is behind the current sequence is skipped. A vacant seat keeps the estimate, the character count, and the block count at 0. A vacant seat keeps the rendered text empty. Any other seat builds a Transcript from the copied cards. The estimate comes from a new HeuristicEstimator. The character count is the length of the rendered transcript. The block count is the transcript turn count. An exception during that work skips the edit. A sequence that fell behind during the work is skipped. A current result is posted through paintLater(TokenSeat, int, int, int, String).
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • take

      private AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenEdit take()
      The method waits until the queue holds an edit. The method returns that edit and removes it from the queue. An interrupt while waiting is ignored. The thread keeps waiting after that interrupt.
      Returns:
      The method returns the next AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenEdit.

    • newerWaiting

      private boolean newerWaiting()
      The method reports whether another edit is already queued.
      Returns:
      The method returns true when the queue is not empty.

    • capture

      private AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenSeat capture(AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenEdit edit)
      The method asks the event-dispatch thread to copy a AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenSeat for edit. The method waits until that copy returns. An exception from the wait returns null.
      Parameters:
      edit - The edit is the cell-input record to copy.
      Returns:
      The method returns the copied seat, or null when the copy failed.

    • paintLater

      private void paintLater(AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenSeat seat, int estimate, int chars, int blocks, String rendered)
      The method posts the result onto the event-dispatch thread. A posted id that is non-empty and is not the focused cell id is dropped. Any other result calls AetherisNotebookPanel.acceptTokenPaint(long, int, int, int, String).
      Parameters:
      seat - The seat is the copy whose sequence and posted id are checked.
      estimate - The estimate is the token count to paint.
      chars - The chars value is the character count to paint.
      blocks - The blocks value is the turn count to paint.
      rendered - The rendered value is the transcript text to paint.
